description: GDScript files. To change an existing line, edit the file's text. Read a rename's leftAlone before calling the rename done. create writes a .uid and puts its class_name in the class list, and an open editor then scans and reloads the changed scripts. ok false after a write leaves the files changed. A rename's lists past 300 lines go to a file under .godot. Operations: create: a new script file; modify (needs modifications): add functions, variables, signals, constants or enums to an existing script; rename (needs symbol, newName): rename a class or a member wherever the engine uses it.

className.description: A class_name for the script. Not with content. For op create.

content.description: The whole file, written as given, instead of a template, className and extends. For op create.

extends.description: The base class. Default the template's class, or Node with no template. Not with content. For op create.

modifications.description: Additions to make, in order. For op modify.

defaultValue.description: Variables and constants: the value as GDScript writes it. A constant needs one.

exportGroup.description: Variables: the inspector group, such as "Stats/Loot", or "" for none. Without it, an export joins the group open below the last variable.

isExport.description: Variables: add @export. Default true with exportHint or exportGroup.

params.description: Functions and signals: the parameters, "delta: float".

position.description: Functions: where to insert. Default end.

values.description: Enums: the members, each a name or "FLEE = 5".

varType.description: Variables and constants: the type annotation.

newName.description: The new name. One already taken is refused. For op rename.

newScriptPath.description: Also move the declaring script here, with its .uid. The paths naming it are rewritten as resource_edit move rewrites them. For op rename.

preview.description: Answer with what would change and what would be left alone, and write nothing. Default false. For op rename.

scriptPath.description: Script file inside the project, such as "scripts/player.gd".

symbol.description: What to rename, declared by the script at scriptPath: its class_name, or a top-level method, variable, constant, signal, enum, enum value or inner class. Everything but a class_name needs the editor open. For op rename.

template.description: A starting shape. resource is written for a Resource and the others for a Node. For op create.

name: script_edit
title: Edit scripts
